rubric: It asks for a decision, not a change: a question, not ready for an agent (no acceptance criteria an agent could verify). Nothing is on fire and nothing can break; the asker wants the decision before more cases are added, so the time is whenever or this cycle, never now: low risk. It is real work or a real question: not a duplicate, not stale, so the archive suggestion is no.

criteria.kind: It asks for an answer or a decision, not a change
criteria.ready: Does the issue have testable acceptance criteria an agent could verify without asking anyone?
criteria.risk_prelim: Isolated code with tests, docs or copy
criteria.archive: Should this be archived instead of worked: a duplicate, out of scope, stale, or nothing an agent can act on?
criteria.who: One person, or an internal tool
criteria.what: A rough edge: a workaround exists

reading.why: It asks whether a cheaper judge is good enough and wants a decision, not a change: a question, not ready for an agent, nothing on fire, low risk, an internal tool and one asker.

ruledOut.question: kind
ruledOut.label: bug
ruledOut.why: It asks for a decision. It is not: Something that works, or should work, is broken.

ruledOut.question: kind
ruledOut.label: feature
ruledOut.why: It asks for a decision. It is not: New behaviour a user or the pipeline can see.

ruledOut.question: kind
ruledOut.label: task
ruledOut.why: It asks for a decision. It is not: A defined piece of work with no new behaviour to design: a migration, a rename, a config change.

ruledOut.question: kind
ruledOut.label: chore
ruledOut.why: It asks for a decision. It is not: Upkeep with no new behaviour: a refactor, dependencies, docs, CI.

ruledOut.question: kind
ruledOut.label: incident
ruledOut.why: It asks for a decision. It is not: Production is down or wrong right now, data is lost, or a secret is exposed.

ruledOut.question: risk_prelim
ruledOut.label: medium
ruledOut.why: Nothing here can break. It is not: Shared code other features depend on.

ruledOut.question: risk_prelim
ruledOut.label: high
ruledOut.why: Nothing here can break. It is not: Auth, payments, data migrations, deletion, CI or infrastructure.

ruledOut.question: archive_reason
ruledOut.label: duplicate
ruledOut.why: The question is real. It is not: Another open ticket asks for the same.

ruledOut.question: archive_reason
ruledOut.label: out_of_scope
ruledOut.why: The question is real. It is not: Not this repository's or team's to do.

ruledOut.question: archive_reason
ruledOut.label: stale
ruledOut.why: The question is real. It is not: Overtaken by events; nobody needs it now.

ruledOut.question: archive_reason
ruledOut.label: not_actionable
ruledOut.why: The question is real. It is not: No change an agent could make or verify.
